_meta.note: This file is the one manual, one-time human input the AHP weighting system needs — the pairwise comparisons themselves, not the weights. Everything downstream (matrix construction, weight derivation, Consistency Ratio check, injection into predictor.py) is fully automated by ahp.py and weight_resolver.py and re-runs on every import with zero manual steps. This mirrors the project convention already used for shoreline_change_rate_m_per_yr and mangrove_cover_pct: a one-time human-sourced input, ingested once, consumed automatically forever after. The comparisons below were seeded by Claude from this project's already-documented literature-backed weights (see WEIGHT_JUSTIFICATION.md) so the pipeline has a working, internally-consistent default on day one — replace them with a real elicitation (2-3 team members, run independently, see judgments/README.md) before treating the resulting CR as evidence of anything beyond internal arithmetic consistency.
